title: Random forest and assays identify novel ACE-inhibitory peptides in duckweed hydrolysates
summary: Random forest, PLS and linear regression and correlation linked peptide ion volumes in 407 peptides to ACE and DPP-IV inhibition. Of 20 selected peptides, 16 showed ACE inhibition and were novel; WKLPMF had ACE IC50 13.40 +/- 0.40 uM and DPP-IV IC50 216.89 +/- 5.15 uM. All activity is in vitro.
ai_technology: Random forest regression with PLS, linear regression and Pearson correlation on peptide ion volumes
organization: PROTEO; Université Laval; Institut sur la nutrition et les aliments fonctionnels (INAF)

evidence.tested: In vitro enzyme inhibition assays of the selected peptides.
evidence.unknown: In vivo activity is not tested and random forest was one of four approaches; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Prioritized peptides for synthesis and testing.
